validation.title: Validation
validation.body: Shows where this product's methods have been checked against public records and published research, before the same methods are applied where no such records exist.
validation.tab.label: Validation
validation.history.title: Inferred history vs. public crop records
validation.history.intro: On each proof field, Field Memory's inferred label (crop or fallow) is shown next to the public crop record for the same season. Both results are shown, whatever they are.
validation.history.summaryBreakdown: Crop called crop: {cropCrop}. Fallow called fallow: {fallowFallow}. Crop called fallow: {cropFallow}. Fallow called crop: {fallowCrop}.
validation.akron.title: Rotation ranking vs. a published long-term trial
validation.akron.intro: This product's Season Replay ranking of two rotations the trial also compared, set next to the direction the trial reported.
validation.akron.productRanking: This product's replay ranks {favored} higher (median score {favoredScore} vs. {otherScore}) on criteria the trial did not use: climate fit, water balance, soil health, erosion, pest-cycle break, forage and an indicative margin, not yield or farm income.
validation.akron.directional: This is a directional comparison only: the trial measured yield and net farm income on research plots over real Akron weather; this product scores stress and soil-health proxies for a sampling area near Akron, so only the direction of the ranking is compared.
validation.akron.error: Could not run the replay for this comparison.
validation.transfer.title: What this does, and does not, prove
validation.transfer.body: Where public crop records and a published trial exist, as on this proof field, this product's methods can be checked against them, season by season and rotation by rotation. Where no such records exist, as on a farmer's own field, the same methods run unchecked by public data; there, the farmer's own confirmation of past seasons takes the place of the public record, and local review stays necessary before acting on a ranking.
validation.loadError: The proof fields could not be loaded. Open one from the Demo fields list once while online, then try again.
validation.sources.body: Three sampling areas near Akron, Colorado, have public crop-type records for every year from 2008 to 2023. Field Memory reads only satellite vegetation history; it never sees these records.
validation.sources.caveat: The public record is a satellite-based crop classification (USDA Cropland Data Layer), not a farmer's own log, and the outlines are sampling areas, not field boundaries. Some disagreement can come from the record itself.
validation.history.reason: Most disagreements are seasons Field Memory calls a crop where the record says fallow. The satellite pixel is 250 m wide and can pick up weeds or a neighbouring field, which makes fallow look green.
validation.provenance.fieldMemory.source: NASA MODIS vegetation index (MOD13Q1), read by Field Memory
validation.provenance.cdl.source: USDA Cropland Data Layer (public crop record)
validation.akron.summary: {agree} of {total} proof fields rank the trial's better rotation higher
validation.akron.disagreeReason: Likely reasons: the replay scores water stress, soil health and erosion, not net income, and a sampling area is not a research plot.
